arxiv-1901-04738.title: Efficient Algorithms to Test Digital Convexity
arxiv-1901-04738.creator: Loïc Crombez, Guilherme D. da Fonseca, Yan Gérard
arxiv-1901-04738.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Loïc Crombez, Guilherme D. da Fonseca, Yan Gérard. A set S ⊂ ℤ d S\subset\mathbb{Z}^{d} is digital convex if conv ⁡ ( S ) ∩ ℤ d = S \conv(S)\cap\mathbb{Z}^{d}=S , where conv ⁡ ( S ) \conv(S) denotes the convex hull of S S . In this paper, we consider the algorithmic problem of testing whether a given set S S of n n lattice points is digital convex.

arxiv-2003-05986.title: Delay Induced Swarm Pattern Bifurcations in Mixed Reality Experiments
arxiv-2003-05986.creator: Victoria Edwards, Philip deZonia, M. Ani Hsieh, Jason Hindes, Ioana Triandaf, Ira B Schwartz
arxiv-2003-05986.description: Abstract Swarms of coupled mobile agents subject to inter-agent wireless communication delays are known to exhibit multiple dynamic patterns in space that depend on the strength of the interactions and the magnitude of the communication delays. We experimentally demonstrate communication delay-induced bifurcations in the spatio-temporal patterns of robot swarms using two distinct hardware platforms in a mixed reality framework.
